abilities.name: technician
abilities.effect: Strengthens moves of 60 base power or less to 1.5× their power.

abilities.name: unnerve
abilities.effect: Prevents opposing Pokémon from eating held Berries.

kanto.flavorText: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

original-johto.flavorText: Behind its lithe, elegant appearance lies a barbaric side. It will tear apart its prey on a mere whim.

hoenn.flavorText: A PERSIAN’s six bold whiskers sense air movements to determine what is in its vicinity. It becomes docile if grabbed by the whiskers.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: A very haughty Pokémon. Among fans, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: A very haughty Pokémon. Among fans, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.

updated-johto.flavorText: Its lithe muscles allow it to walk without making a sound. It attacks in an instant.

original-unova.flavorText: A very haughty Pokémon. Among fans, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.

updated-unova.flavorText: A very haughty Pokémon. Among fans, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.

kalos.flavorText: Its lithe muscles allow it to walk without making a sound. It attacks in an instant.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Persian has six bold whiskers that give it a look of toughness. The whiskers sense air movements to determine what is in the Pokémon’s surrounding vicinity. It becomes docile if grabbed by the whiskers.

original-alola.flavorText: It has a high opinion of itself, although not to the same extent as the Alolan Persian. It’s quite difficult to make friends with this Pokémon.

updated-alola.flavorText: This Pokémon is popular with rich people. It’s also targeted by hunters who are after the jewel in its forehead.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: The gem in its forehead glows on its own! It walks with all the grace and elegance of a proud queen.

swsh.flavorText: Its elegant and refined behavior clashes with that of the barbaric Perrserker. The relationship between the two is one of mutual disdain.
